bullets.text: Cyclone Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged houses and vehicles in Chennai, and the office should monitor weather alerts.
Thiruvallur district suspended 61 TASMAC employees for striking against the empty bottle return rule, and the office must watch labor tensions.
The collector and monitoring officer inspected Pulicat beach as Cyclone Murasu warnings remained in place for Chennai and Thiruvallur.
An ambulance got stuck in heavy traffic near Kamatchi Hospital on Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road in Pallikaranai due to rain and office hours.
Gummidipoondi block development office faced a protest as sewage vehicle owners parked vehicles inside, which the office should monitor.
Liquor sales were barred within 5km of the Andhra border in Thiruvallur ahead of Chittoor polls, and the office should track border enforcement.
Avadi City Police arrested four men for robberies and vehicle thefts across commissionerate limits, and the office should watch crime rates.
Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity by 2029, placing Chennai at the center of data-centre expansion.
Corning began its Chennai cover-glass plant while expanding Pune optical manufacturing for the AI data center market.
AI-based data centers in Tamil Nadu are growing rapidly, with capacity expected to increase significantly over six years.
